_metadata.description: Disparities in access to cardiac genetic testing, cardiovascular clinical trial representation, and gene therapy availability. Data compiled from published literature and public health surveys for educational purposes.
sources: Journal of the American College of Cardiology — Genetic Testing Disparities (2023)
Nature Reviews Genetics — Global Gene Therapy Landscape (2024)
_metadata.notes: These are composite estimates based on multiple studies, used here for educational illustration only.

testing_by_race.title: Access to Cardiac Genetic Testing by Race/Ethnicity
testing_by_race.subtitle: Percentage of eligible patients who received cardiac genetic testing
testing_by_race.source_note: Composite estimate from NHGRI and JACC (2023) — rates reflect likelihood of receiving genetic testing after a cardiac diagnosis.

testing_by_income.title: Genetic Testing Access by Household Income Quintile
testing_by_income.subtitle: Percentage with access to cardiac genetic testing services
testing_by_income.source_note: Estimated from insurance claims data and genetic counseling referral rates (2022-2024).

trial_representation.title: Representation in Cardiovascular Genetics Clinical Trials
trial_representation.subtitle: Share of trial participants vs. share of U.S. population by race/ethnicity
trial_representation.source_note: Analysis of ClinicalTrials.gov demographic reporting (2022-2024) vs. U.S. Census Bureau estimates.

global_access.title: Estimated Patient Access to Cardiac Gene Therapies by Region
global_access.subtitle: Projected percentage of eligible patients able to access advanced therapies
global_access.source_note: Projected from gene therapy approval timelines, healthcare infrastructure, and cost data (Nature Reviews Genetics, 2024).
